description.value:
You spray a thick adhesive mesh into a 20-foot cube extending from a point within range, for the duration. The mesh functions as difficult terrain and lightly obscures its area. Unless anchored between two solid surfaces or spread across a floor, wall, or ceiling, it collapses on itself and the power ends at the start of your next turn; mesh spread over a flat surface has a depth of 5 feet.

Any creature that starts its turn in the mesh, or enters it during its turn, must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be restrained for as long as it stays within the mesh or until it breaks free. A restrained creature can use its action to attempt a Strength check against your tech save DC to escape.

The mesh is flammable — any 5-foot cube of it exposed to flame burns away within 1 round, dealing 2d4 fire damage to any creature that starts its turn in the flames.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
